faq.q: What is the origin of Nebahat?
faq.a: Nebahat is associated with Arabic. Nebahat is the Turkish form of Arabic نَبَاهَة (Nabāha), meaning 'eminence, distinction'.
Yes — the underlying form نَبَاهَة is Arabic.
Nebahat can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
